reason: User prioritizes MDO-targeted adaptation; ordinary fine-tuning is deferred to a later ablation.
calibration_and_test: sealed; no fields fetched or evaluated in this pilot

loss.cl: squared error of CL re-integrated from fields, divided by 0.01 squared
loss.cd: squared error of CD re-integrated from fields, divided by 0.0005 squared
loss.spanwise: span-width-weighted squared dCL/deta error divided by 0.5 squared
loss.target_source: all physical targets derived from the same published CFD surface fields
loss.note: Spanwise nondimensional loads are not a completed conservative FEM nodal-force interface.

dev_policy: Report all results; choose any follow-up changes on Dev only, keep Calibration/Test sealed. This pilot does not complete v1 or establish blind-test performance.
cfd_policy: A few explicitly matched cases, run to convergence with solver checks; no arbitrary ten-minute cap, no full CFD dataset. No equal-accuracy speedup claim if definitions or accuracy do not match.
